filter.description: A regular expression pattern to test against the message content. Supports `#{translation.key}` placeholders to match translations across all languages.
filter.markdownDescription: A regular expression pattern to test against the message content. Supports `#{translation.key}` placeholders to match translations across all languages.

before_action.description: Executed on the player *_if_* the filter matches, just before the message is cancelled.
before_action.markdownDescription: Executed on the player *_if_* the filter matches, just before the message is cancelled.

after_action.description: Executed on the player *_if_* the filter does *_not_* match (and no earlier filter in the same power matched), after the message is allowed.
after_action.markdownDescription: Executed on the player *_if_* the filter does *_not_* match (and no earlier filter in the same power matched), after the message is allowed.

replacement.description: If set, matched text in the message is replaced with this string (supports regex capture groups like `$1`, `$2`, etc.).
replacement.markdownDescription: If set, matched text in the message is replaced with this string (supports regex capture groups like `$1`, `$2`, etc.).

prevent.description: If `true`, the message is blocked entirely when this filter matches.
prevent.markdownDescription: If `true`, the message is blocked entirely when this filter matches.
